record.question: Proteins may be denatured irreversibly by:

record.question: A facultative parasite is one that:
options: Lives on the surface of the host
Cannot survive without a specific vector
Can exist both freely and as a parasite
record.explanation: Answer D: Can exist both freely and as a parasite. A facultative parasite can live independently in the environment but can also adopt a parasitic existence; this contrasts with an obligate parasite. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/parasites/about/.
